title: Story premise EDU044: The Same Request Wears Two Coats
summary: Idea-stage learning premise (language/communication). Hook: What does this reader already know? Takeaway/theme: Adapt context and tone to the reader while preserving the underlying request.
description: A teammate needs the same missing file from a close colleague and an unfamiliar organizer, but copies a context-heavy shorthand message to both. Adding necessary context adapts the second request without changing its purpose.
